items.title: Uniform estimate for the smooth part of the multiplicative convolution sum
items.author: Tony Haddad; Dimitris Koukoulopoulos
items.work: On Arratia's coupling and the Dirichlet law for the factors of a random integer
items.difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the unlabelled lemma at source lines 1394-1399: for x beyond a universal threshold and for a level between two and the fourth power of the logarithm, the smooth part of the convolution sum is bounded by a constant times the logarithm of the level over the square root of the level, times an explicit factor in which the two weights appear. The author gave it no label, so its position in the article is part of its identity. The proof (source lines 1401-1446) proceeds by splitting every divisor into its square-free and square-full parts, which turns the sum into a product of a sum over square-free parts and a sum over square-full parts; the values of the function on square-free arguments are then rewritten through the exponents attached to the prime factors, and the resulting sum is estimated with a standard summatory bound and partial summation, which is where the explicit dependence on the level and on the two weights is produced. The statement records only the final shape of the bound.

primary.label: unlabelled lemma at source lines 1394-1399 (the estimate from which the bound for the fourth event follows)
